text_simplified: The text speaks about the tarbiyah (upbringing) of daughters and the importance of teaching them household tasks and cooking so they may become righteous wives. It mentions that the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ advised ihsan (excellence) toward daughters, and that whoever has three daughters and treats them with ihsan, they will be a shield for him from the Fire. It also notes that the mother shares in this reward with the father if she performs their tarbiyah well.
